description:
Turns a country name, alias or code (English, Japanese, Chinese) into ISO codes: matches[] {iso2, iso3, name, score}, best first, max 5, empty if none. Call it first when you only have a name: get_country_facts, check_entry_requirements, get_trip_brief and the other tools take ISO codes. Exact, prefix (3+ chars) or substring (4+) match, ignoring case and punctuation; no spelling correction. Names only (CLDR): no sources or confidence.
Parameters: pass query as the user wrote it; if nothing matches, retry with the official or local name. lang only localizes the returned names. Examples: {"query":"日本"}, {"query":"South Korea","lang":"ja"}.
Read-only; free and keyless, no quota.

lang.description: Language for localized names (BCP 47). Supported: en, ja, zh-Hans, zh-Hant; aliases such as zh, zh-CN, zh-TW and zh-HK are mapped, and anything else falls back to English. Only names are localized; verbatim official quotes stay in their original language.

query.description: Country name, alias or code, in English, Japanese or Chinese. Case-, space- and punctuation-insensitive (a leading "the" is ignored); matches exactly, by prefix (3+ characters) or by substring (4+ characters); not a spelling corrector.

name: resolve_country

matches.description: Up to 5 matches, best first. Empty when nothing matches.

matched.description: The name or code that matched.

anyOf.description: Only on error results (isError: true): RFC 9457 problem, e.g. unknown country, no data, key required, rate limited, sanctions block.
anyOf.title: Error (problem details)

anyOf.description: Only on error results (isError: true): x402 v2 payment requirements. Pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"].
anyOf.title: Error (x402 payment request)

title: Resolve country
